cards.text: This one starts after a heavy loss, friend. Two sons of Aaron, Israel's high priest, have died when they approached the presence of the LORD. After that, the LORD speaks to Moses, Aaron's brother and Israel's leader, with a message for Aaron.

cards.question: The LORD says Aaron must not enter freely into the Most Holy Place behind the veil. What does He say would happen if Aaron did?

cards.text: The LORD tells Moses why: "I appear in the cloud above the mercy seat." Friend, if that were me, my eyebrows would be SWEATING just walking past that veil.
So the LORD lays out exactly how Aaron enters, and this is NOT a recipe you wing. First, Aaron brings a young bull and a ram.

cards.question: Aaron's young bull is for a sin offering, and his ram is for a burnt offering.

cards.text: Next, the outfit: a sacred tunic, undergarments, a sash and a turban. These are holy garments, and every piece is made of the same thing.

cards.question: What are Aaron's tunic, undergarments, sash and turban all made of?
Aaron must bathe himself with water before he puts on the holy garments.

cards.text: Aaron's own animals are set. Now he takes animals from the congregation of Israel: a ram for a burnt offering, plus some male goats for a sin offering.

cards.question: From the congregation of Israel, Aaron takes ___ male goats for a sin offering.

cards.text: First up, Aaron presents the bull as a sin offering. The goats are watching from the side like it's the opening act.

cards.question: Who does Aaron make atonement for with the bull for his sin offering?

cards.text: Then Aaron presents the two goats before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. One for the LORD, one for the scapegoat, and both goats looking at each other like, "Wait. Which one of us is which?"

cards.question: How does Aaron decide which goat is for the LORD and which is the scapegoat?
The goat chosen by lot for the LORD is sacrificed as a sin offering. What about the scapegoat?

answers.text: It is sent into the wilderness alive
It is sacrificed on the altar too
It is kept at the Tent of Meeting

cards.text: Now Aaron slaughters the bull for his own sin offering. Then he takes a censer full of burning coals from the altar, plus two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense, and goes inside the veil.

cards.question: Aaron puts the incense on the fire before the LORD. The cloud of incense covers the ___ above the Testimony.
The cloud of incense is there so that Aaron will not die.

cards.text: Still behind the veil, Aaron takes some of the bull's blood. He sprinkles it with his finger on the east side of the mercy seat.

cards.question: Then Aaron sprinkles the bull's blood with his finger in front of the mercy seat ___ times.

cards.text: Next, Aaron slaughters the goat for the sin offering for the people. He brings its blood behind the veil too.

cards.question: What does Aaron do with the goat's blood behind the veil?

answers.text: He sprinkles it like the bull's blood
He pours it out beside the ark
He mixes it into the incense

cards.question: Aaron makes atonement for the Most Holy Place itself. What reason does the LORD give?

answers.text: The sins of the nations nearby
The sins of Egypt left behind

cards.text: Then he does the same for the Tent of Meeting, which abides among them in the midst of their impurities. Not across town from the mess, friend, RIGHT in the middle of it.

cards.question: While Aaron makes atonement in the Most Holy Place, other people can wait inside the Tent of Meeting.

cards.text: Once Aaron has made atonement for himself, his household and the whole assembly, he's still not done. Aaron's step counter is going THROUGH the roof, friend.

cards.question: Aaron takes some of the bull's blood and some of the goat's blood. Where does he put it?

answers.text: On all the horns of the altar
On the posts of the tent door
On the corners of the veil

cards.question: Aaron sprinkles blood on the altar seven times to cleanse it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.

cards.text: The Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting and the altar are all purified. Now Aaron brings forward the live goat.

cards.question: Aaron lays both hands on the live goat's head. Then what does he do?

answers.text: He confesses all Israel's sins over it
He ties a scarlet cord on its horns
He anoints its head with oil

cards.question: Aaron leads the live goat out into the wilderness himself.

cards.text: Instead, Aaron sends the goat away into the wilderness by the hand of a man appointed for the task.

The goat carries all their iniquities on itself into a solitary place, and the man releases it into the wilderness. ALL of it on one goat, and I used to complain when somebody set a cookie box on top of me.
Then Aaron goes back into the Tent of Meeting, takes off the linen garments and leaves them there. He bathes in a holy place and puts his own clothes back on.

cards.question: Back in his own clothes, Aaron goes out to sacrifice. What does he offer now?

answers.text: His burnt offering and the people's
A second bull for the people
A lamb for the other priests

cards.text: He also burns the fat of the sin offering on the altar. Now, remember the man who walked the scapegoat out into the wilderness?

cards.question: What must the man who released the scapegoat do before he can come back into the camp?

answers.text: Bring an offering of his own

cards.text: The bull and the goat whose blood went into the Most Holy Place are taken outside the camp.

cards.question: Outside the camp, what happens to the bull and the goat for the sin offering?

answers.text: Everything left goes to the priests

cards.question: The one who burns the bull and the goat can walk right back into the camp without washing.

cards.text: Then the LORD makes this a permanent statute, on the tenth day of the seventh month. Put it on the calendar, friend, and NO snooze button.

cards.question: This day comes with everything we just saw about Israel's sins. On it, the people shall ___ themselves and not do any work.
This day is only for native Israelites, not for the foreigners who reside among them.
Why is this day such a big deal for Israel?

answers.text: Atonement will be made to cleanse them
It marks the day they left Egypt
It marks the end of the harvest

cards.text: The LORD calls it "a Sabbath of complete rest for you" so that they may humble themselves. Complete rest. No oven, no timer, NOTHING. My mustache wouldn't know what to do with itself.

cards.question: After Aaron, who will make atonement on this day?

answers.text: The priest ordained to succeed his father
Whoever the elders of Israel choose
The oldest man from each tribe

cards.text: He puts on the sacred linen garments and makes atonement for the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting and the altar. And for the priests and all the people of the assembly.

cards.question: This permanent statute is to make atonement ___ a year for the Israelites because of all their sins.

cards.text: The passage closes with this: "And all this was done as the LORD had commanded Moses."
